mapper.insert: INSERT INTO turns (tuid, uid, session_id, tid, parent_tid, user_json, ai_json, created_at, last_accessed_at) VALUES (#{tuid}, #{uid}, #{sessionId}, #{tid}, #{parentTid}, #{userJson}, #{aiJson}, #{createdAt}, #{lastAccessedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tuid, uid, session_id, tid, parent_tid, user_json, ai_json, created_at, last_accessed_at FROM turns WHERE session_id = #{sessionId,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ByteArrayTypeHandler} AND parent_tid = #{parentTid} ORDER BY tid ASC
